title: Rotate CCS job settings object
summary: Documents the rotate_ccs_job_settings object used with Redis Software REST API calls.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
| Name | Type/Value | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| cron_expression | string | [CRON expression](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron#CRON_expression) that defines the CCS rotation schedule |
| enabled | boolean (default: true) | Indicates whether this job is enabled |
| file_suffix | string (default: 5min) | String added to the end of the rotated RDB files |
| rotate_max_num | integer, (range: 1-100) (default: 24) | The maximum number of saved RDB files |
